current_evidence: The council's 'Validation checklist' download page (sandwell.gov.uk/downloads/download/427/validation-checklist) offers only this one PDF, whose cover reads 'September 2023'; a web search found no newer official Sandwell list.

issues.detail: Affordable Housing Statement (M10) is placed under Householder. The source applies it to schemes of 10 or more dwellings. The trigger excerpt also merges M10 with the householder and change-of-use exemption wording from M9 (Contaminated Land), so it reads as if it applies to householder applications.
issues.evidence: M10 Type of application: 'All applications for 10 or more dwellings.'

issues.detail: The Householder checklist (Section 3, H1-H13) was not captured as householder requirements. Its local items are: H6 Streetscene drawing (where roof heights increase), H7 Sections (where there are clear level differences), H10 Levels information (ground level change over 300mm), H11 Existing and proposed parking (where bedrooms are added), H12 Heritage Statement (where designated heritage assets are affected) and H13 Sunlight path / 45-degree code (where neighbours' light or outlook is affected). Grokbot filed streetscene, sections, heritage and 45-degree items under Full planning only.
issues.evidence: Section 3 Householder Application Checklist H1-H13, e.g. 'H11 Existing and proposed parking, where bedrooms are added'

issues.detail: Outline, Reserved matters and Listed building consent are all recorded as '(none)' (national requirements only). Section 4 of the source ('All other applications', N1-N13, M1-M17, S1-S8) applies to every non-householder type. Listed building consent is named explicitly in N8 (Design and Access Statement) and M16 (Heritage Statement).
issues.evidence: N8 DAS: 'major development, dwellings or buildings of 100 sqm+ in designated areas, and listed building consent'; M16 Heritage Statement includes listed building consent

issues.detail: About 28 requirements carry the note 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', for example Arboricultural report (M17), Heritage Statement (M16), Contaminated land (M9), Noise (M2), Viability (M12), Sequential test (M14) and EIA screening (M15). Section 4 applies these to all non-householder applications (outline, reserved matters, LBC where relevant), not to Full planning alone.
issues.evidence: Section 4 heading: 'All Other Applications' - National (4.1), Mandatory Local (4.2), Supporting (4.3)

issues.detail: Coal Mining / Land Stability Risk Assessment (M8) is placed under Householder, but its own trigger excerpt says householder applications are excluded.
issues.evidence: '...required to support all planning applications for development within these areas (except for householder and other exempt developments)'

issues.detail: Proposed Landscape Scheme (S8) is placed under Householder and Advertisement consent. S8 excludes shop fronts, advertisements, changes of use and householder applications. The trigger excerpt is also garbled: it is interleaved with table header text ('Supporting Documents Number Information Required Type of Application Guidance Justification') and cut off.
issues.evidence: S8: 'All detailed applications (excluding shop fronts, advertisements, changes of use ... and householder applications)'

issues.detail: Planning Statement (S2) is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval' and 'Minerals & waste (county)'. S2 covers major full applications, including change of use (not prior approval), and explicitly excludes waste and mineral applications.
issues.evidence: S2: 'All major applications ... including change of use applications ... except for waste management and mineral development applications'

issues.detail: The mineral safeguarding impact assessment (S7) is placed under 'Minerals & waste (county)'. S7 applies to NON-mineral development inside the Mineral Safeguarding Area, near Areas of Search or quarries, or on mineral infrastructure sites, so it belongs under Full/Outline planning. Sandwell is a unitary authority, and the source sends waste and minerals applications to separate forms (V33/V34).
issues.evidence: S7: 'Non-mineral developments within the Mineral Safeguarding Area (MSA) falling within the policy thresholds'

issues.detail: Several mandatory local requirements are missing. M1 CIL Additional Information Form and Assumption of Liability (applications creating new retail or residential floorspace). M3 Air Quality Impact Assessment/mitigation (developments in areas not meeting air quality objectives, per Black Country AQ SPD Table 1). M6 Flood Risk Assessment (Flood Zones 2/3 and specified areas; Flood Zone 1 sites of 1ha or more).
issues.evidence: M1: 'Planning applications that create new Retail or Residential floor space.'; M3: 'Developments within areas where air quality does not, or is unlikely to, meet air quality objectives'

issues.detail: These supporting-document requirements are missing. S6 Education and Health Facilities Statement (proposals involving the loss of a health or education facility). S4 Impact assessment for waste management facilities (loss of a waste site, or sensitive uses next to one). S3 Noise and vibration assessment (major industrial/commercial schemes, or sensitive uses in noisy or vibration-affected areas). M7 Habitat survey (sites within or next to designated wildlife sites).
issues.evidence: S6: 'Proposals involving the loss of a health or education facility.'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are fragments that do not say when the requirement applies. Archaeological Assessment: 'minimum include a Desk Based Assessment...' (no trigger). Viability Assessment: 'to the Viability Assessment also required.' (source M12: 10+ residential units where affordable housing is not provided for viability reasons). Transport Assessment: 'If a Transport Assessment is not required, highways may Guidance development.' (source M4: significant traffic generation per SPD thresholds). Ecological Survey: 'All planning applications periods ... on sites where protected the following items' (garbled). Water efficiency: ends in table header text.
issues.evidence: Grokbot app_type_rows trigger_excerpt values vs source M4, M12, M16, M7

issues.detail: The Design and Access Statement trigger excerpt is actually text from the minerals (Policy MIN1) item and does not describe when a DAS is needed. Source N8: major development; dwellings or buildings of 100 sqm or more in designated areas; listed building consent.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: 'In accordance with Policy MIN1 of the Black Country Core Strategy (2011)...'

issues.detail: 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' is mislabelled. The excerpt is S5 (waste management development proposals, i.e. waste facilities), not bin and recycling storage for ordinary development.
issues.evidence: S5: 'All proposals for waste management development (including proposals to expand, upgrade or relocate existing waste facilities)...'

issues.detail: Some rows have the wrong trigger or are labelled with the wrong requirement. 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' uses block-plan text about trees and parking positions. 'Cycle parking details' comes from M5 Parking Plan, whose trigger (floorspace or use changes that add parking demand) is not given. 'Fire Statement' omits the threshold (18m+ or 7+ storeys residential, N13), which is a national requirement.
issues.evidence: N13: 'Buildings of 18 metres or more in height, or of seven or more storeys for residential purposes.'

issues.detail: Some items Grokbot lists are not requirements. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is advice to seek pre-app, not a validation document. 'Gypsy & Traveller information' is a note on wording the description of development. The tab item 'If this information is included it will not be redacted. 3 .0 HOUSEHOLDER APPLICATION CHECKLIST:' is a fragment of process text plus a section heading.
issues.evidence: 'You are advised to seek pre-application advice from the LPA prior to submitting your application...'

issues.detail: The Biodiversity Net Gain row quotes a forward-looking note ('expected to be required from November 2023'), not a local list requirement. Statutory BNG is now in force, so this row is stale and gives no trigger. The list itself still cites NPPF 2021 and predates BNG; Grokbot correctly flagged it as more than 2 years old.
issues.evidence: '...at least 10% biodiversity net gain, expected to be required from November 2023.'

issues.detail: The List date (2023-09-01) comes from PDF metadata. The month matches the document's cover date, 'September 2023', but the date basis should be the document text and the precise day is not stated.

summary: Grokbot links to Sandwell's current (and only) validation checklist, dated September 2023 on its cover. The extraction has many problems: the Householder H1-H13 checklist was missed, items were misplaced under Householder/Adverts (affordable housing, coal mining, landscaping), and CIL, air quality, flood risk and education/health statements are missing. Outline, reserved matters and LBC are wrongly recorded as having no local requirements, and many trigger excerpts are garbled fragments.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
